svg.title: Helios battery port | analogue sensing
svg.text: Battery port voltage and current sensing
Rev A | One pack-referenced channel per battery port
Force current stays in the power bus.
KELVIN_P faces the pack positive terminal.
PACK_0 is local to this battery port.
Provide local supply and digital isolation
before crossing to the central controller.
Transfer = Vpack x 8.2 / 176.2. Nominal filter pole 2.04 kHz.
3.3 V local rail. Place C2 at pins 5 and 4. Positive current means discharge.
V(I_ADC) = 1.65 V + 10 mV/A x Ipack. Telemetry only; independent hardware trip required.
CIRCUIT STUDY / Pack-side electronics / Layout and hardware qualification pending
